high_level_description: The image depicts an aerial view of a large, serpentine sculpture on a beach. The sculpture is designed to resemble the skeleton of a sea serpent, with a long, curved body extending into the ocean. The structure appears to be made of metal or a similar material, with visible bones and vertebrae forming the outline of the creature. The beach is sandy, and the waves are gently lapping against the shore where the sculpture begins. A person is standing near the base of the sculpture, providing a sense of scale to emphasize the size of the installation.
